text.en:
A domestic primary gold producer shall, upon application, be entitled to receive such assistance
as may be fixed by executive order of the President of the Philippines upon recommendation of the Monetary
Board of the Central Bank. The production of primary gold mines shall be disposed of in accordance with
applicable Central Bank regulations.

The assistance herein provided shall be administered by the Gold Mining Industry Assistance
Board created under Republic Act No. 3089, as amended. The provisions of the said Act not inconsistent
herewith are hereby continued in force.

There are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated such sums as may be necessary to provide for the assistance herein established as well as to
provide for the additional expenses of the Gold Mining Industry Assistance Board in the administration of the
assistance.

To meet the funding requirements of the assistance herein established, the Central Bank of the
Philippines is hereby authorized to pay into the General Funds of the National Government out of prior years'
profits realized from its sales of gold, such amounts as may periodically be sent aside by the Monetary Board
for the purpose.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th date of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
seventy-seven.
